facts.text: Sensor simulation still reproduces heavy rain and short-range precipitation clutter poorly; this limitation is well supported across sources.
facts.quote: Heavy rain and precipitation clutter at short range.

facts.text: Sensor simulation still reproduces non-uniform airborne dust, its time dynamics, and real mine-dust particle distributions poorly.
facts.quote: Non-uniform airborne dust and its time dynamics, and real mine-dust particle distributions.

facts.text: Sensor simulation still reproduces lens and cover soiling poorly, including how soiling accumulates, dries, and is cleaned.
facts.quote: Lens and cover soiling, including how it accumulates, dries and is cleaned.

facts.text: Sensor simulation still reproduces vibration-induced errors poorly.
Learned methods still reproduce night and artificial lighting poorly in sensor simulation.
facts.quote: Night and artificial lighting in learned methods.

facts.text: Neural rendering still reproduces extrapolated viewpoints poorly.
Sensor simulation still reproduces multipath from large metal structures and material piles poorly, including double reflections even after material tuning.
facts.quote: Multipath from large metal structures and material piles; double reflections even after material tuning.

facts.text: Sensor simulation still reproduces thermal scenes poorly in general.
Long-range weather effects beyond chamber length remain poorly reproduced.
facts.quote: Long-range weather effects beyond chamber length.

facts.text: Sensor simulation still poorly reproduces combinations of dense dust with wet or muddy covers, reflective metal with wet ground, and night work lights with airborne particles.
facts.quote: Combinations: dense dust plus wet or muddy covers, reflective metal plus wet ground, night work lights plus airborne particles.

facts.text: A 2026 rainfall-credibility paper recommends converting a test facility's nominal rain intensity to an "equivalent rainfall" along the sensing path.
facts.quote: A 2026 rainfall-credibility paper argues that a facility's nominal rain intensity should be converted to an "equivalent rainfall" along the sensing path [86].

facts.text: Even physical test facilities need their own credibility check when evaluating rainfall effects on sensing.
facts.quote: Even physical test facilities therefore need their own credibility check

facts.text: A 2019 survey notes that test chambers cannot fully replace real weather.
facts.quote: a 2019 survey notes that chambers cannot fully replace real weather [76].
